9	Use this routing before adding files:

28	## 2. WebGL Lifecycle Rules
29	
30	> Canonical source for WebGL ownership boundaries. AGENTS.md and frontend.md point here; do not restate.
31	
32	- Ownership: main/about/contact flow `AppManager` → `AppEngineRuntime` → `Engine`. Works scatter is the only standalone secondary renderer (`pages/works/render/WorksSceneManager.ts`).
33	- Main renderer lifecycle is `AppEngineRuntime.init()` -> `Engine.init()` -> `Engine.start()` -> `Engine.dispose()`.
34	- Main renderer resize path is `ResizeSetup` / `ResponsiveRuntime` -> `Engine.applyResponsiveSnapshot()` -> `Engine.setViewport()` -> `PostProcessor.resize()` and `BackgroundManager.resize()`.
35	- `WorksSceneManager` is the current secondary-renderer exception. It owns its own `WebGLRenderer`, RAF loop, `window.resize` listener, and must clean all of them in `dispose()`.
36	- Secondary renderers must call both `renderer.dispose()` and `renderer.forceContextLoss()`.
37	- `Engine.dispose()` must stop the loop, dispose post-processing/background/model loader/scene, detach context listeners, then dispose the renderer.
38	- `Scene.dispose()` must dispose registered `SceneObject`s and then object graphs.
39	- Event listeners, RAFs, timers, observers, Theatre subscriptions, and scene subscriptions must have symmetric cleanup.
40	
41	## 3. Three.js Hot Path Rules
42	
43	Hard rules for `runUpdate`, `render`, RAF callbacks, and other per-frame paths:
44	
45	- Do not allocate `new Vector2`, `new Vector3`, `Matrix4`, `Quaternion`, `Euler`, arrays, sets, or object literals per frame.
46	- Use instance scratch fields and mutate with `.set()`, `.copy()`, `.applyMatrix4()`, etc.
47	- Do not call `scene.getObjectByName()` per frame. Use `context.getObject(id)` or subscribe through `Scene.onObjectRegistered`.
48	- Do not call `Object.keys()`, `Array.from()`, or `new Set()` in a hot path unless the source changes rarely and the result is cached.
49	- Call `ResponsiveRuntime.getDefault().getSnapshot()` once per frame at most and pass the local snapshot down.
50	- Do not assign texture uniforms per frame. Set texture uniforms once; update scalar/vector uniforms only.
51	- Do not call `renderer.setSize()` inside the render loop.
52	
53	Known current exceptions to treat carefully:
54	
55	- `WorksSceneManager` currently creates small pointer sample object literals during pointer events, not per-frame rendering.
56	- `Engine.setFollowObject()` may clone a center vector when a follow object is assigned, not every frame.
57	
58	## 4. Disposal Checklist
59	
60	| Creates | Must release |
61	|---|---|
62	| `addEventListener` | `removeEventListener` with the same function reference |
63	| `setTimeout` / `setInterval` | `clearTimeout` / `clearInterval` |
64	| `requestAnimationFrame` / `FrameScheduler.request` | matching cancel call |
65	| `MutationObserver`, `IntersectionObserver`, `ResizeObserver` | `.disconnect()` |
66	| `THREE.BufferGeometry` | `.dispose()` |
67	| `THREE.Material` | `.dispose()` plus owned texture slots |
68	| `THREE.Texture` | `.dispose()` or register via `SceneObject._ownedTextures` |
69	| `THREE.WebGLRenderTarget` | `.dispose()` |
70	| `THREE.Light` with target | remove light and target, then dispose if supported |
71	| `Element.animate()` | `.cancel()` |
72	| Theatre subscription | call returned unsubscribe |
73	| Scene pub/sub subscription | call returned unsubscribe |
74	
75	Use `utils/disposeObject3D.ts` for object graph disposal. Use `removeAndDispose(node)` when the object should also be detached from its parent.
76	
77	## 5. Responsive Rules
78	
79	- Shared responsive state comes from `ResponsiveRuntime`.
80	- New cross-page responsive behavior should subscribe to `ResponsiveRuntime` and unsubscribe in `dispose()`.
81	- Existing works scatter resize is direct `window.resize`; follow its cleanup pattern only for standalone secondary renderers.
82	- Prefer `snapshot.device.isMobile`, `snapshot.breakpoint`, `snapshot.reducedMotion`, and `snapshot.render.clampedPixelRatio` over ad-hoc `window.innerWidth`, UA sniffing, or per-component `matchMedia`.
83	- Reduced motion must degrade autoplay/parallax/infinite motion paths.
84	
85	## 6. Theatre Rules

87	- Add main/about/contact Theatre variants through `PageTheatreBinder` adapter factories.
